description: This file provides utility functions for managing .roo configuration directories and files, including locating global and project-specific directories, discovering subfolder directories, checking existence of files/directories, reading files safely, and loading/merging configuration content from multiple .roo directories.

methods.name: getGlobalRooDirectory
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the global .roo directory based on the current platform.

methods.name: getProjectRooDirectoryForCwd
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the project-local .roo directory for a given current working directory, preferring .roo unless a .kilocode directory exists.

methods.name: directoryExists
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a directory exists at the specified path.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a file exists at the specified path.

methods.name: readFileIfExists
methods.description: Reads a file asynchronously, returning null if the file does not exist or is a directory.

methods.name: discoverSubfolderRooDirectories
methods.description: Uses ripgrep to find all subfolder .roo directories within the workspace, excluding node_modules and .git.

methods.name: getRooDirectoriesForCwd
methods.description: Returns an array of directories to check, starting with global, then project-local.

methods.name: getAllRooDirectoriesForCwd
methods.description: Returns an array of all relevant .roo directories including global, project-local, and subfolder directories.

methods.name: getAgentsDirectoriesForCwd
methods.description: Returns parent directories containing .roo folders or relevant files, from root to subfolders.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads and merges configuration files from global and project-specific .roo directories based on a relative path.

methods.name: loadRooConfiguration
methods.description: Alias for loadConfiguration, maintained for backward compatibility.
